title: useToggle Hook
description:
Implement a `useToggle` hook that returns `[value, toggle, setOn, setOff]`. The boolean starts at `initial` (default `false`).

**Example:**
```tsx
const [isOpen, toggle, setOn, setOff] = useToggle(false);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: implementing toggle as setValue(!value), which reads the stale closure value. The functional updater form setValue(v => !v) always flips the current state correctly.
